verdict.rationale: Formant documents event-driven automation: events can trigger commands on devices, such as running scripts or publishing ROS topics, and events can fire webhooks to any HTTP endpoint. Its operations pages also claim automated incident response and configurable alerts. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how rule conditions are defined (thresholds, filters, logic), any AI-native or natural-language rule authoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: We can also use events to trigger commands
A webhook allows you to make an API call to any endpoint over HTTP based on a trigger from a Formant event.
